JORN4_A.name: JORN4_A pooled evaporation-stress calibration, harmonic, d=0, E=1

provenance.properties: DERIVED SURROGATES, not measured hydraulic values: Saxton-Rawls 2006 regression outputs from NEON megapit texture/density with the declared floors; prescribed bounded sensitivity inputs of the existing soil_layers; the native provider default recipe is not adopted and no derived air entry is fed as a measured override

receipt.effective_density_rule: max(raw_density,1000kg/m3,0.901*normal_density), applied after raw-density soil-texture/OM layer assembly.

provenance.evaporation_stress: one shared constant calibrated to the pooled observations of all three windows (empirical threshold, not theta1500)

labels.raw: measured/provider inputs retained in the receipt

provenance.scope: dry-down window diagnostic only: T=0, gravity on, no storm/rain/LEAF/wind/bed, no field ET closure claim
provenance.historical_evaporation_stress: top-layer predicted theta1500, fixed within a run (earlier comparison; superseded for this protocol)

stress_calibration.label: empirical evaporation-stress threshold (volumetric fraction) calibrated to pooled observed changes; NOT the measured theta1500 / wilting point; all three windows are used in the fit (mechanism diagnostic, no held-out claim)

site.latitude_source: NEON JORN megapit DP1.00096.001 permegapit decimalLatitude 32.590520 (measured pit location, not a plot GPS)
